## About
Wayne Electric is a local, family owned and operated shop focused on one thing: the electrical side of your vehicle. We sell, service and repair starters, alternators and batteries, we re-manufacture starters and alternators, and we track down the electrical problems that leave you stuck.
We began as a one man business and have grown into a team of experienced technicians. We work on all makes and models, and because we sit in the port of Long Beach, we often help the boats in the harbor with battery repairs and electrical troubleshooting.
Customers from Orange County and Los Angeles County come to us, and we hold a 4.4 rating from 117 Google reviews.

## Services
- Starter and alternator repair: We sell, service and repair starters and alternators for all makes and models.
- Deka batteries: We sell and service batteries and specialize in Deka, a reliable, sturdy brand.
- Electrical systems diagnostics and repair: Complete diagnostics and repair of electrical systems, right here in Long Beach.
- Boat electrical service: Battery repairs and electrical troubleshooting for the boats in the harbor.

## FAQ
Q: What are your hours?
A: We're open Monday through Friday from 8:00 AM to 4:30 PM. We're closed on Saturday and Sunday.

Q: Do you work on my make and model?
A: Yes. We work on all automotive makes and models.

Q: Do you work on trucks, motorhomes and boats?
A: Yes. If your car, truck, motorhome or boat has an electrical problem, give us a call.

Q: Can I get a quote before bringing my vehicle in?
A: Yes. Call us for a complimentary consultation and a free quote by phone.
